sources.title: NPPF: promoting healthy and safe communities
sources.facts: Sets policy for open space, sport, recreation, playing fields and healthy communities.
sources.guard: National policy does not establish local need, surplus or permission.

sources.title: Open space, sports and recreation facilities and local green space
sources.facts: Explains assessment, consultation and Local Green Space considerations.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a specific site is designated, surplus or replaceable.

sources.title: Planning for sport
sources.facts: Collects Sport England planning roles, guidance, tools and needs-assessment resources.
sources.guard: A hub does not determine a particular application or facility need.

sources.title: Playing fields policy
sources.facts: Explains consultation duties and policy exceptions for development affecting playing fields.
sources.guard: Policy exceptions require case-specific evidence and do not imply approval.

sources.title: Planning applications
sources.facts: Explains statutory consultation, application assessment and current service information.
sources.guard: Consultation guidance does not prove Sport England's response or decision outcome.

sources.title: Assessing Needs and Playing Pitch Strategy guidance
sources.facts: Provides current guidance for evidence on sport and recreation facility needs.
sources.guard: Method guidance does not prove current local deficits, surpluses or deliverability.

sources.title: Making Local Green Space designations in your neighbourhood plan
sources.facts: Covers evidence, engagement, audit and policy-making for Local Green Space designation.
sources.guard: A toolkit does not designate land or prove policy weight or examination success.

sources.title: Playground Fund: guidance for recipient local authorities
sources.facts: Covers inclusive design, consultation, safety, procurement, maintenance and environmental considerations.
sources.guard: Funding guidance does not prove award, land control, permission, procurement or completion.
